# SoraPopover

A non-modal panel anchored to its trigger, using the Popover API and CSS anchor positioning.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | overlays |
| Import | `import { SoraPopover } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraPopover from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraPopover'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraPopover.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraPopover.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `triggerLabel` | `string` |  | Text of the built-in trigger button. Use the `trigger` slot for richer content. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading of the panel. With `title` (or `label`) the panel is a named, non-modal dialog. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the panel when there is no visible title. |
| `placement` | `SoraPlacement` | `'bottom-start'` | Preferred position relative to the trigger. It flips when there is no room. |
| `variant` | `SoraVariant` | `'outline'` | Appearance of the built-in trigger. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` | `'neutral'` | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `dismiss` | `'auto' \| 'manual'` | `'auto'` | `auto` closes on outside click and Escape; `manual` only through the model. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | default `false` | Whether it is open. Stays in sync with the native element, however it was opened or closed. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `props: { close: () => void }` | Panel content. |
| `trigger` | `props: { open: boolean }` | Content of the library-owned trigger button. |
| `custom-trigger` | `props: SoraTriggerBindings` | A fully custom trigger: bind `attrs`, `on` and `ref` on its native element. |

## Exposed

Available on a template ref of the component.

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | method |  |
| `close` | method |  |
| `toggle` | method |  |

## Attributes

The built-in trigger button. With a custom trigger, bind `attrs`/`on`/`ref` yourself.

## Keyboard

- Enter or Space on the trigger toggles the panel.
- Tab moves from the trigger into the panel (it follows the trigger in the DOM).
- Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.

## Accessibility

- The trigger has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
- With `title` or `label` the panel is a named non-modal `role="dialog"`; otherwise it is a plain disclosure.
- Light dismiss and focus return are native (`popover="auto"`).

## Styling

- `.sora-popover`, `.sora-popover__title`
- `data-placement`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  <SoraPopover
    :trigger-label="t('demo.popover.trigger')"
    :title="t('demo.popover.title')"
    data-testid="popover-trigger"
  >
    <template #default="{ close }">
      <p class="mb-3 max-w-56 text-sora-sm text-sora-muted">{{ t('demo.popover.body') }}</p>
      <SoraButton size="sm" @click="close">{{ t('demo.popover.copy') }}</SoraButton>
    </template>
  </SoraPopover>
  <!-- A custom trigger binds attrs, listeners and the element ref explicitly. -->
  <SoraPopover placement="top" :label="t('demo.popover.title')">
    <template #custom-trigger="{ attrs, on, ref: setTrigger, open }">
      <button
        :ref="setTrigger"
        type="button"
        v-bind="attrs"
        class="rounded-sora border border-sora-border-strong px-3 text-sora-md"
        style="min-block-size: max(2.25rem, var(--sora-hit-min))"
        v-on="on"
      >
        {{ t('demo.open') }} ({{ open ? '−' : '+' }})
      </button>
    </template>
    <p class="max-w-56 text-sora-sm">{{ t('demo.popover.body') }}</p>
  </SoraPopover>
</div>
```
